meta.title: 单个到期 occurrence 从 scheduler patrol、已提交订阅状态、认领、执行、收拢到结果投影

controlContract.receipt: SubscriptionControlReceipt { subscriptionId, action, status, policyRevision, scheduleRevision, idempotencyKey, requestHash, supersededUnclaimedOccurrences, controlRef }
controlContract.competition: subscription-control commits typed state and receipt; this graph reads committed subscription state and rechecks state/revision in the same JSONL transaction before claim; no cross-graph edge or second control truth
linearization: control committed before claim supersedes old unclaimed occurrences; claim returns typed stale/conflict and cannot start new execution
claim committed before control keeps the authorized immutable policy snapshot for that executionEpoch; future pause/cancel-future does not stop in-flight execution
two modifies from the same base revision produce exactly one applied receipt and typed stale/conflict for the losers
duplicate idempotencyKey with the same requestHash returns the existing receipt; different content returns conflict
resume generates deterministic future slots and never reissues superseded occurrences
journal restart replay restores committed subscription state and receipts

executionContract.recoveryIdentity: OccurrenceTaskBinding { occurrenceId, subscriptionId, scheduleRevision, occurrenceOrdinal, taskId, operationId, executionEpoch, inputArtifactDigest }
executionContract.requiredReceipt: ServeTaskTerminalReceipt { taskId, operationId, executionEpoch, inputArtifactDigest, verification: TaskVerificationResult, terminalCheckpointRef, settlementReceiptRef, recoveryResponsibility }
executionContract.verificationAuthority: W3 retained tree public task-verification bridge in packages/runtime/src/ui-runtime/task-verification.ts exists in this candidate; the occurrence terminal receipt derives its verification from the really committed coordinator checkpoint (packages/app/src/ui-runtime/occurrence-terminal.ts) and the scheduler does not own a second verifier
executionContract.settlementRule: settle_occurrence consumes only a verified serve-task terminal/settlement receipt; checker failed/missing/rejected, identity mismatch, stale executionEpoch, or pending verification cannot be projected as occurrence success; cancelled requires a settled stop
executionContract.identityFencing: core validates task/operation/executionEpoch/inputArtifactDigest; JSONL atomically commits occurrence settle and receipt
executionContract.replayRule: execute_occurrence_task executes or resumes exactly one business execution for OccurrenceTaskBinding; duplicate, concurrent, and restart calls return or await the same terminal receipt and never dispatch a second business execution; settlement and verification receipts remain authoritative
executionContract.consumerCapability: DELIVERED: OccurrenceConsumerRouter implements ServeTaskConsumerPort with ownsFirstAdmissionAuthority=true and delegates to DurableOccurrenceConsumer.forTaskCycle over the persisted OccurrenceTaskBinding; execute-or-resume, authoritative checkpoint settlement and TaskVerificationResult are proven by the production same-entry acceptance test (tests/app/scheduler-production-wiring.test.ts) and the durable consumer suites
executionContract.crossGraph: typed invocation of the public serve-task input/output contract; no cross-graph node edge, back-edge, second lifecycle, or second persistence truth

recoveryContract.busyReminder: schedule({busy:true}) commits occurrence=reminder-pending and reminder=pending; the same slot with schedule({busy:false}) in recover_pending_reminder atomically commits occurrence=due and reminder=consumed only when active current revision is not invalidated and existing late/max/end rules still permit execution; when latePolicy=skip and nowAt > dueAt, it instead atomically commits occurrence=skipped-busy and matching reminder=invalidated, consumes the ordinal with existing skipped-busy accounting, and marks subscription exhausted when maxOccurrences is reached
recoveryContract.slotIdentity: recovery preserves original occurrenceId, subscriptionId, scheduleRevision, occurrenceOrdinal, and dueAt for both due recovery and skipped-busy late closure; it never recreates the slot, bypasses claim, executes a skipped slot, or introduces a browser timer
recoveryContract.busyRetry: a repeated busy schedule returns the existing reminder-pending occurrence; after late-skip closure, repeated schedule returns the same skipped-busy occurrence and never adds a second reminder
recoveryContract.controlCompetition: modify, pause, and cancel-future invalidate matching unclaimed occurrences and pending reminders in the control transaction; recovery cannot revive them
recoveryContract.restart: JsonlOrganJournal replay restores reminder-pending, pending reminder, late-skip closed skipped-busy plus invalidated, claim, and settlement state before recovery, claim, or idempotent replay
recoveryContract.executionRecovery: recovery of an interrupted execute-before-settle window is consumer-owned by OccurrenceTaskBinding; the scheduler does not add a generic execution registry or duplicate terminal truth

terminalContract.success: publish_occurrence_result only after verified serve-task terminal/settlement receipt and atomic occurrence settle
terminalContract.failure: non-success verification remains a non-success occurrence outcome with recovery responsibility; attention.opened with retry-scheduler-patrol
terminalContract.cancelFuture: subscription cancelled before occurrence claim; in-flight stop is separate
terminalContract.cleanup: occurrence consumed, skipped-busy, or invalidated; matching reminder consumed or invalidated; lease released; journal receipt retained
terminalContract.executionRecovery: duplicate, concurrent, or restarted execute-or-resume returns the same execution terminal identity without a second business dispatch

executionModeContract.once: 单个 dueAt 到期的合法触发；执行成功后 occurrence 进入 consumed 终态
executionModeContract.scheduled: startAt 到期的单个计划触发；执行成功后 occurrence 进入 consumed 终态
executionModeContract.recurring: 按 intervalMinutes/cadence 生成的每个 occurrence 都是独立 SESE 子图；每次触发使用新的 occurrenceId 与 ordinal，不回写上一 occurrence 的任务真源

meta.occurrenceIsolation: 每次 occurrence 从 read_committed_subscription_state 重新建立独立执行身份；不在跨功能 DAG 中画回边或复用上一执行的状态
meta.controlIsolation: pause 或 cancel-future 只使尚未 claim 的 occurrence/reminder 失效；已 claim 的在途执行由 serve-task stop/settle 独立收口，不能在调度图内自动停止

schedulerPatrolContract.scope: 只读取已存在 Subscription 并按 dueAt 调用 SubscriptionControlPort.list/dueTimes/schedule/claim/consumeExecution/settleOccurrence；不创建 Subscription，不执行任务轮次
schedulerPatrolContract.terminal: 每个 tick 用 consumeExecution→settleOccurrence 收拢已 claim 的 occurrence；端口不可读时以 typed issue scheduler.plans-unreadable/scheduler.plan-failed 暴露，无 supervisor lease 时以 scheduler.lease.unavailable 显式失败且不 dispatch，不伪装 occurrence 成功

meta.productionWiringGap: due 时间触发已由 packages/app/src/ui-runtime/scheduler.ts 的 UiRuntimeScheduler 在 startUiRuntime 内按真实时钟组装并驱动 schedule→claim→consumeExecution→settleOccurrence；production app 已把已确认草稿 revision 的 executionPolicy 经 SubscriptionControlPort.create 落成 Subscription（packages/app/src/ui-runtime/service.ts:3257 persistAuthorizedExecutionPlan→:3295 port.create），并已组装 OccurrenceConsumerRouter/DurableOccurrenceConsumer。真实剩余缺口：(1) 已 claim 且未 settle 的 occurrence 在 owner 仍存活但结果未知时按 in-progress 拒绝重新 dispatch，进程内 unknown-outcome 停摆不会自愈；(2) patrol 间隔大于约 1s 时 latePolicy=skip 的槽位可能错过；(3) dueTimes/policySlotOrdinal 每 tick 为 O(总槽位)，需要游标或闭式解；(4) 已闭合：订阅 pause/resume/cancel-future 语义的唯一 owner 是 packages/runtime/src/subscriptions/index.ts 的 SubscriptionControlPort.control，production 入口 POST /api/plans/{subscriptionId}/control 经 packages/app/src/ui-runtime/service.ts 的 UiRuntimeService.controlExecutionPlan 调用该 owner；本图不新增控制入口，只读取已提交的订阅状态；scheduler runTick 遍历全部 persisted plan，非 active plan 只是不再领取新槽位，其已提交但未收拢的 claim 仍由 step 1 resume 并 settle 收口，控制与到期派发仍是两条独立边。原重复实现 SchedulerPatrol.pause/resume 只是该 owner 的纯转发，已随 packages/runtime/src/explicit-brain/scheduler-patrol.ts 在本轮 validation-ablation 物理删除，删除未移除任何已接线能力
